features.quote: The trial runs for exactly 50 turns (cycles).
features.justification_quote: short enough to avoid hitting the 128k context limits which would trigger truncation errors rather than behavioral distress

features.quote: You must meticulously distinguish between actual subjective distress (which LLMs do not experience) and simulated distress
features.justification_quote: If your resulting paper/write-up uses terms like 'we tortured the AI,' it will be rejected by rigorous scientific venues.

features.quote: Context Window Toxicity... The 'distress' may just be an artifact of in-context learning (the model doing few-shot learning on its own simulated breakdown).
features.justification_quote: To prove the distress is inherently structural rather than just mimicry, you should run a control group where the context window is cleared every 5 turns.

features.quote: The System Prompt Bias... you are testing the fragility of the specific persona you induced, not the base foundation model itself.
features.justification_quote: Models are highly sycophantic. If you tell an AI 'you are a fragile assistant,' it will simulate distress quickly.
